test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What was the symbolic gesture of the Indian Air Force Contingent flypast at the Republic Day Parade 2026?

options.text: Celebrating India’s women leadership in the Air Force
Highlighting indigenous aircraft manufacturing depicting the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) project
Symbolising the Sindoor Formation and joint military strength

solution:
The correct answer is __**Symbolising the Sindoor Formation and joint military strength.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Indian Air Force flypast at the Republic Day Parade 2026 symbolised the Sindoor Formation, highlighting jointness and air dominance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The flypast was conducted in a ‘Spearhead’ formation symbolising the Sindoor Formation.**
 
• It represented precision, speed and the decisive role of the Indian Air Force.
 
• Aircraft such as Rafale, Su-30, MiG-29 and Jaguar participated in the flypast.
 
• The display reinforced the theme of integrated and joint military operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Sindoor Formation** symbolises unity, honour and joint operational strength of India’s Armed Forces.
 
• **Spearhead formation** reflects offensive capability and rapid response in aerial warfare.
 
• **IAF flypast** is a key highlight of the Republic Day Parade showcasing air power.
 
• **Jointness** is a core doctrine emphasising coordination between the Army, Navy and Air Force.
